rubble.label: Passable rubble between the mage and the Borg
rubble.explanation: Original: the rubble counts as a wall the mage cannot step onto, danger 0, borg_caution() does nothing. Corrected: the mage can step onto the rubble and cast, danger 208; the Borg flees the level ('# Fleeing the level (recall)') and the real read activates Word of Recall.
